svg.text: 五蕴、八苦、三类苦、十二处与十八界

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 五蕴 Five Aggregates

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 人就是这五者聚合，没有固定我

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 色 Form — 物质身体

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: material body

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 受 Feeling — 感受

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: feeling

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 想 Perception — 认知、概念化

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: perception, conceptualization

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 行 Formations — 意志、造作

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: volition, mental formations

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 识 Consciousness — 了别、意识

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: awareness, consciousness

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 记住一句：念头不是我，情绪不是我，五蕴聚合不是我

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 八苦 Eight Sufferings — 苦的展开，4+3+1

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 前四：生、老、病、死

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Birth, aging, sickness, death

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 中三：爱别离、怨憎会、求不得

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Separation, meeting disliked, not getting what wanted

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 后一：五蕴炽盛（忧悲恼）

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Burning aggregates, sorrow and distress

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 日常用：先给难受起个名字，就是观的开始

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 三类苦 Three Types of Suffering

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 苦苦 — 苦上加苦

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Suffering of suffering, pain upon pain

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 坏苦 — 乐坏了就苦

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Suffering of change, happiness turns to pain

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 行苦 — 条件聚合本身就不安稳

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Suffering of conditioned existence, unstable by nature

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 十二处与十八界 Sense Bases and Elements

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 六根 Six senses：眼、耳、鼻、舌、身、意

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, mind

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 六境 Six objects：色、声、香、味、触、法

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Form, sound, smell, taste, touch, phenomena

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 十二处 = 六根 + 六境

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Twelve bases = six senses + six objects

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 十八界 = 十二处 + 六识（见闻嗅尝觉知）

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Eighteen elements = twelve bases + six consciousnesses

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 六识：见、闻、嗅、尝、觉、知

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Seeing, hearing, smelling, tasting, feeling, knowing

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: 连回十二因缘：根 + 境 + 识相遇 = 触，触生受

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

g.text: Sense + object + consciousness meet = contact, contact → feeling

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

svg.text: 记住方法：先记名字，再记一个生活例子，不要先背定义

text.font-family: Kaiti SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif

svg.text: First names, then one life example, not definitions first
